mapper.select: SELECT /* homes.broker.mapper.BrokerMapper.selectComplexList */ CPXNO, ARCD, LEGCD, BUN, JI , BULD_NM AS BULDNM , MAIN_PPS_CD AS PPSCD , PPS_NM AS PPSNM , SUM(HSHLD_CO) AS HSHLDCO , COUNT(1) AS DNGCNT FROM TB_BD_COMPLEX A LEFT JOIN TB_CM_REGSTR_PPSCODE B ON ( A.MAIN_PPS_CD = B.PPS_CD ) WHERE ARCD = #{arcode} AND LEGCD = #{legcd} AND MAIN_PPS_CD = '02000' /* 공동주택만 검색함 */ GROUP BY CPXNO, ARCD, LEGCD, BUN, JI, BULD_NM, MAIN_PPS_CD, PPS_NM
